info.name: Public Share Control
info.summary: Control what visitors can create and simplify uploads on public share links
info.description:
Public Share Control gives share owners and administrators more control over what visitors can do on public folder links.
**Restrict the "New" menu per link.** In a link's sharing settings, the owner chooses which entries of the "New" menu visitors see — for example, allow uploads but hide "New folder", text documents, spreadsheets, whiteboards or "Add folder description". Uploading itself always stays available.
**One-click uploads for visitors.** Links that allow uploads get an "Upload files" button right next to "Public share", on every screen size. Name conflicts are handled with Nextcloud's own dialog (Cancel, Keep both, Replace). File requests keep Nextcloud's own upload page.
**Defaults and restrictions for administrators** (Administration settings → Sharing):
- *Hidden by default:* entries hidden on every link whose owner hasn't changed the selection. - *Forbidden:* entries hidden on all links, including existing ones. Owners can't turn them back on. - A switch to turn the "Upload files" button off for the whole server.
Hiding menu entries changes what visitors see, not what the link permits: a link that allows uploads still lets visitors create files by other means, e.g. WebDAV.
info.author: Nico Störzbach
